You might want to take a look at this excellent paper on recursive LLM agent harnessing for open-world tasks. See link below. #AI #LLMAgents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224

Ruiyao Xu, Yanfei Chen, Zhongying CuiZhu, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Yifei Ming, Han Yu, Rujun Han, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224 https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14224 https://arxiv.org/html/2610.14224

Harness^2 is a recursive agent harnessing framework for open-world tasks. The paper reports gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB. Builders should treat the harness as part of the system.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224
